description: Customer CSV export writes untrusted notes exactly as stored. Spreadsheet apps may interpret cells beginning with formula control characters as formulas.
evidence: Demo verification: /api/customers/export.csv exports a note beginning with =HYPERLINK(...) without neutralization.
safe_rewrite: Quote CSV fields, escape embedded quotes, and neutralize cells beginning with =, +, -, or @ before export.
title: CSV formula injection risk in customer export
